chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He was asked about a man who performs ghusl, then finds moisture, while he had urinated before performing ghusl. He said: “If he had urinated before the ghusl, then he does not repeat the ghusl.”
ai.seo_question: If someone finds moisture after ghusl for janabah, must the ghusl be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning post-ghusl moisture found after ritual purification from janabah. It states that if a person had urinated before performing ghusl, then finding later moisture does not require repeating the ghusl.
